metrics.definition: total_agents in 8004scan's statistics API (mainnet view), read 2026-11-14 at 02:45Z UTC on 2026-11-15; the home page showed 2,062,883 at the same time. It was 561,614 on 2026-10-11 and 699,098 on 2026-10-18.
metrics.caveat: Registrations, not working agents: census work in the erc-8004 dossier finds a small minority expose a working endpoint. The tripling since 2026-10-18 came mostly in two batch waves, on Base (2026-10-20 to 2026-10-23) and on Arc Mainnet (2026-11-01 to 2026-11-06), whose sampled registrations all point to Central City; Central City itself claims about 1.48 million agents (vendor claim). 8004scan does not index 0G, a mainnet in the contracts README, whose registry had issued ids up to 3,941,206 on 2026-11-14 (sampled ids point to EvoEvo), so on-chain registrations across chains exceed 6 million by highest id. Explorer method not published.

metrics.definition: total_feedbacks in 8004scan's statistics API (mainnet view), read 2026-11-14; it was 682,172 on 2026-10-11 and 720,771 on 2026-10-18.
metrics.caveat: Includes Sybil feedback; counts are not reputation quality. Feedback grew far more slowly than registrations over the same weeks.

metrics.definition: Networks shown on the 8004scan home page, read 2026-11-14 (29 on 2026-10-18; 30 on 2026-10-11).
metrics.caveat: Not the same list as the 25 mainnets in the official contracts README: the statistics API lists 30 mainnet chains, including some the README omits such as Arc, leaves out 0G, a README mainnet, and no longer lists Abstract.

metrics.definition: total_users in 8004scan's statistics API, shown as Unique Wallets on its home page, read 2026-11-14; it was 496,840 on 2026-10-11 and 755,027 on 2026-10-18.
metrics.caveat: Wallets are not people or operators. On 2026-11-14 the count was about 1.6 times the agent count, and the newest 100 ids on Base and on Arc, all Central City registrations, each had a different owner address.

metrics.metric: Adobe: growth in generative AI referral traffic to US retail sites, holiday 2025
metrics.definition: Visits to US retail sites from clicks in generative AI tools, 2025-11-01 to 2025-12-31, compared with the same period in 2024 (Adobe Analytics).
metrics.caveat: Measures traffic, not purchases or agent-executed payments; growth from a small base.

metrics.metric: Bain forecast: US agentic commerce by 2030
metrics.definition: US retail purchases that AI agents initiate, influence or complete by 2030, 15 to 25 percent of US online retail; simple AI-assisted search excluded.
metrics.caveat: Forecast, not an observation. Forecasts use different definitions and must not share an axis with observed volumes.

metrics.metric: Keyrock: on-chain transactions by AI agents
metrics.definition: Count of on-chain transactions Keyrock attributes to AI agents, May 2025 to April 2026.
metrics.caveat: Secondary report; includes x402 traffic that other analysts adjust for wash activity.

metrics.metric: Keyrock: on-chain value settled by AI agents
metrics.definition: On-chain payments that Keyrock attributes to AI agents from May 2025 to April 2026, nearly all in USDC.
metrics.caveat: Seed said the year to May 2026; ForkLog gives May 2025 to April 2026 and one French report gives April 2025 to May 2026. Report not read directly; attribution of transactions to agents is the author's method. asOf is the end of the reported window (month precision).

metrics.metric: McKinsey forecast: global revenue orchestrated by agents by 2030
metrics.definition: Global goods revenue orchestrated by AI agents by 2030; excludes services and B2B.
metrics.caveat: Forecast, not an observation. Forecasts use different definitions and must not share an axis with observed volumes. Month precision (October 2025).

metrics.metric: McKinsey forecast: US B2C revenue orchestrated by agents by 2030
metrics.definition: Revenue from US business-to-consumer goods purchases that AI agents orchestrate by 2030, under moderate merchant-readiness assumptions; goods only.
metrics.caveat: Forecast, not an observation. Forecasts use different definitions and must not share an axis with observed volumes. Month precision: McKinsey dates the report October 2025; the seed day 2025-10-17 was not confirmed. 'Orchestrated' is the broadest definition among the forecasts here.

metrics.metric: Morgan Stanley forecast: US agentic e-commerce by 2030, base case
metrics.definition: Agentic gross merchandise value in US e-commerce by 2030, base case (about 10 percent of US e-commerce).
metrics.caveat: Forecast, not an observation. Forecasts use different definitions and must not share an axis with observed volumes. Date is the first press report (2025-12-09); the seed date 2025-12-08 and the Morgan Stanley report were not reached directly.

metrics.metric: Morgan Stanley forecast: US agentic e-commerce by 2030, bull case
metrics.definition: Agentic gross merchandise value in US e-commerce by 2030, bull case (about 20 percent of US e-commerce).
metrics.caveat: Forecast, not an observation. Forecasts use different definitions and must not share an axis with observed volumes. Secondary reports only.

metrics.metric: Salesforce: online holiday sales influenced by AI and agents, 2025
metrics.definition: Global online sales from 2025-11-01 to 2025-12-31 that Salesforce attributes to AI and agents (recommendations, engagement and agents), out of $1.29 trillion total.
metrics.caveat: Influence attribution by a vendor, not agent-executed payments; global, not US-only.

metrics.definition: Distinct senders, which the home page labels Agents, in the 7-day window of MPPscan's protocol statistics, read 2026-11-14 (3,259); 3.7 thousand were shown on 2026-10-11.
metrics.caveat: Agents are payer addresses as the explorer defines them. Indexed data ends about 2026-11-11, so the window holds about 3.6 indexed days.

metrics.definition: Distinct recipients, which the home page labels Servers, in the 7-day window of MPPscan's protocol statistics, read 2026-11-14; 167 were shown on 2026-10-11.
metrics.caveat: Indexed data ends about 2026-11-11, so the window holds about 3.6 indexed days.

metrics.definition: Transactions in the 7-day window of MPPscan's protocol statistics, the home page default, read 2026-11-14 (62,011); 127.4 thousand were shown on 2026-10-11.
metrics.caveat: Third-party explorer; method not published. MPPscan's indexer appears to have stopped about 2026-11-11T17:15Z (newest indexed transaction among its top servers, while Tempo kept producing blocks), so this window holds only about 3.6 indexed days: do not read the lower figure as a fall in activity. Per indexed day this window's count matches the 2026-10-21 reading (about 17,200 a day in both) while value per day more than doubled; the 30-day window, normalized the same way, shows about a quarter fewer transactions a day than on 2026-10-21.

metrics.definition: Payment value in the 7-day window of MPPscan's protocol statistics, read 2026-11-14 (1,797.04 USD); 1.49 thousand USD were shown on 2026-10-11.
metrics.caveat: Third-party explorer; covers MPP payments it can see on chain, not Stripe card charges through Shared Payment Tokens. Indexed data ends about 2026-11-11, so the window holds about 3.6 indexed days.

metrics.definition: Cumulative MPP payment value measured by Visa and Artemis, data to 2026-04-21, across about 115,000 transfers.
metrics.caveat: Secondary report of the Visa and Artemis study; about five weeks after MPP's public launch.

metrics.metric: Artemis 'Gamed Tx' share of x402 transactions
metrics.definition: Average share of x402 transactions Artemis flagged as gamed, 2025-11-09 to 2026-02-07; peak 90.21 percent.
metrics.caveat: Secondary analysis; detection logic unpublished.

metrics.definition: History: distinct buyers shown on the x402.org counter, first archived on 2025-12-14 and last seen on 2026-10-24; the counter was gone from the page by 2026-11-14.
metrics.caveat: Addresses, not people; a static displayed value, removed between 2026-10-24 and 2026-11-14.

metrics.definition: History: distinct sellers shown on the x402.org counter, first archived on 2025-12-14 and last seen on 2026-10-24; the counter was gone from the page by 2026-11-14.
metrics.caveat: A static displayed value, removed between 2026-10-24 and 2026-11-14.

metrics.definition: History: the value shown on the x402.org home page counter, first archived on 2025-12-14 and last seen on 2026-10-24; the counter was gone from the page by 2026-11-14.
metrics.caveat: Displayed value, never a live 30-day measurement: the page showed the same four values, with no date, in every archived copy from 2025-12-14 to 2026-10-24. x402.org removed the counter without an announcement between 2026-10-24 and 2026-11-14 (home page edited 2026-10-27). Show only as history, never as current activity.

metrics.definition: History: the value shown on the x402.org home page counter, first archived on 2025-12-14 and last seen on 2026-10-24; the counter was gone from the page by 2026-11-14.
metrics.caveat: Same caveat as the transactions counter: a static displayed value, removed between 2026-10-24 and 2026-11-14; raw volume includes activity that Artemis adjusts away.

metrics.metric: Visa and Artemis: adjusted x402 transactions
metrics.definition: Cumulative x402 transactions after Artemis adjustment, data to 2026-04-21; average about $0.14.
metrics.caveat: On 2026-07-16 The Defiant reported Visa's Cuy Sheffield citing about $19 million across about 134 million adjusted transactions, with no data date.

metrics.metric: Visa and Artemis: adjusted x402 volume
metrics.definition: Cumulative x402 payment value excluding identified wash and test activity (Artemis's proprietary method), from the May 2025 launch to 2026-04-21.
metrics.caveat: Raw cumulative total was over $135.7 million across 178.3 million transactions. Report published 2026-07-14, commissioned by Visa.
